== Jumps.plainReturn (line 2)
| plainReturn(a)
  alternative
    | a > 0?
    -
      jump
        | return
    -
  call
    | work()

== Jumps.loops (line 9)
| loops(values)
  instruction
    | sum := 0
  for style=TRAVERSAL
    | foreach v in values
    -
      alternative
        | v < 0?
        -
          instruction color=ff0000 disabled
            | continue;
        -
      alternative
        | v > 100?
        -
          jump
            | break
        -
      instruction
        | sum := sum + v
  jump
    | return sum
! line 13: Continue

== Jumps.labels (line 23)
| labels(grid)
  instruction
    | found := -1
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to grid.length - 1
    -
      for style=COUNTER
        | for j := 0 to grid[i].length - 1
        -
          alternative
            | grid[i][j] == 0?
            -
              instruction
                | found := i
              jump
                | break outer
            -
          alternative
            | grid[i][j] < 0?
            -
              instruction color=ff0000 disabled
                | continue outer;
            -
  jump
    | return found
! line 25: Label
! line 33: Continue

== Jumps.fail (line 40)
| fail(message)
  jump
    | throw new IllegalStateException(message)

== Jumps.work (line 44)
| work()
